description: This file defines a command-line setup command using the Commander library for Swift. The command writes a default configuration file to a specified path, involving loading and saving configuration data.

classes.name: SetupCommand
classes.description: A command-line command for setting up default configuration, conforming to ParsableCommand from the Commander library.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the setup command; creates a default config and writes it to the specified path.
